Note::is_blank¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::is_blank() const

Test Whether A Cell Has No Visible Content¶

is_blank() reports, for each cell, whether it is empty or contains only ASCII whitespace (space, \t, \n, \r, \f, \v). It is the “is this field effectively empty?” check — the one to use for filtering blank rows, counting missing values, or deciding whether a cell needs a default.

The difference from is_whitespace is the empty case: is_blank("") is 1, is_whitespace("") is 0. is_blank treats the empty string and a whitespace-only string the same way.

Return value¶

A Bool Note with the receiver’s shape, one native truth value per cell. Use bools() for a borrowed contiguous host view.

Example 1: A Batch¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note({"", "  ", "\t", " x ", "x"});
const auto mask = n.is_blank();
std::cout << "[";
for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mask.bools().size(); ++i)
  std::cout << (i ? ", " : "") << static_cast<int>(mask.bools()[i]);
std::cout << "]\n";

Output¶

[1, 1, 1, 0, 0]

The empty cell, "  ", and "\t" are all blank; " x " and "x" have a letter.

See Also¶

  • Note::is_whitespace: all-whitespace but not empty.

  • Note::strip: trim boundary whitespace (a blank cell strips to "").
